ModMetaData.name: Wealth Tweaks
ModMetaData.author: lemonade
ModMetaData.description:
Adjust the wealth value of items, apparel, weapons, buildings, floors, and pawns. Set a global multiplier, fine-tune entire categories at once, or override individual items with per-def sliders.
Features: - Three-layer system: global, category-level, and per-item multipliers (they stack) - Category browser with subcategories (Apparel > Headgear, Weapons > Ranged, etc.) - Search bar to find any item by name or defName - Fine-tune buttons for precise 0.05x adjustments - Changes apply live, no restart needed - Only affects colony wealth, does not alter trade prices - Works with mod-added items automatically
Access the editor from Options - Mod Settings - Wealth Tweaks.
Requires Harmony.
